issues.title: Ambiguous Concurrency Policy for Boolean Flags
issues.why: The spec mandates 'is/has' prefixes but doesn't specify thread-safety requirements (e.g., atomic vs volatile) for these flags in Go/C#.
issues.fix: Add a rule to P1 stating that cross-goroutine/thread boolean flags must use atomic types or mutex protection.

issues.title: Unresolved External Linter References
issues.why: References to 'linter-scripts/validate-guidelines.py' and 'codegen' tools are mentioned as authoritative but the scripts themselves are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Inline the core logic of the 'validate-guidelines' regex or provide the script content.

issues.title: Missing Units for Function Metrics
issues.why: Rule 6 mentions 'Functions: 8–15 lines' but doesn't specify if this is Logical Lines of Code (LLOC) or Physical Lines (including comments/whitespace).
